title: Mass Data Run for SAP Sales & Service Cloud V2 — Built the Clean Core Way
author: elam_bharathy_kuppusamy
text: Mass Data Run Out was one of the most-used admin features in SAP Cloud for Customer — and is not part of SSC V2's core — by design. This post documents a BTP extension that brings it back: configurable business objects, customer-specific action APIs, scheduled batch execution, and record-level failure logging. Built clean core.

title: SAP CDP and Maxxing: Integrating Loyalty and Customer Data on SAP BTP
author: elam_bharathy_kuppusamy
text: Loyalty platforms know what customers buy. Customer data platforms know who they are. This post documents a real-world bidirectional integration between Maxxing and SAP Customer Data Platform, built on SAP BTP Cloud Integration — covering what flows, how the middleware was designed, and what to watch out for if you face the same requirement.
